sql: WITH RECURSIVE walk(start, cur, path, depth) AS (SELECT from_crate, to_crate, from_crate || '>' || to_crate, 1 FROM crate_edges UNION ALL SELECT w.start, e.to_crate, w.path || '>' || e.to_crate, w.depth + 1 FROM crate_edges e JOIN walk w ON e.from_crate = w.cur WHERE w.depth < (SELECT count(DISTINCT from_crate) + 1 FROM crate_edges) AND (position(e.to_crate IN w.path) = 0 OR e.to_crate = w.start)) SELECT DISTINCT start, path FROM walk WHERE cur = start
SELECT from_crate, count(DISTINCT to_crate) AS n FROM crate_edges GROUP BY from_crate ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT callee, count(DISTINCT caller) AS n FROM calls_m GROUP BY callee ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT s.kind, count(*) AS n FROM symbol s LEFT JOIN refs r ON r.callee = s.symbol WHERE r.callee IS NULL GROUP BY s.kind ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM symbol
SELECT s.symbol, s.kind, s.file FROM symbol s LEFT JOIN refs r ON r.callee = s.symbol WHERE r.callee IS NULL AND s.file NOT LIKE 'tests/%' AND s.file NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' USING SAMPLE 25 ROWS

SELECT s.symbol, s.kind, s.file FROM symbol s LEFT JOIN refs r ON r.callee = s.symbol WHERE r.callee IS NULL AND s.file NOT LIKE 'tests/%' AND s.file NOT LIKE '%/tests/%' ORDER BY hash(s.symbol) LIMIT 30

SELECT count(*) AS zero_ref, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ('/' || regexp_replace(s.symbol, '^rust-analyzer cargo \S+ \S+ ', '')) LIKE '%/tests/%' OR ('/' || s.file) LIKE '%/tests/%') AS test_excluded FROM symbol s LEFT JOIN refs r ON r.callee = s.symbol WHERE r.callee IS NULL

WITH z AS (SELECT s.symbol, s.kind, s.name, s.file, s.def_line, regexp_replace(s.symbol, '^rust-analyzer cargo \S+ \S+ ', '') AS p FROM symbol s LEFT JOIN refs r ON r.callee = s.symbol WHERE r.callee IS NULL), nt AS (SELECT * FROM z WHERE NOT (('/' || p) LIKE '%/tests/%' OR ('/' || file) LIKE '%/tests/%')) SELECT count(*) AS non_test, count(*) FILTER (WHERE regexp_matches(p, 'impl#\[[^\]]*\]\[[^\]]*\]')) AS trait_impl FROM nt

WITH z AS (SELECT s.symbol, s.kind, s.name, s.file, s.def_line, regexp_replace(s.symbol, '^rust-analyzer cargo \S+ \S+ ', '') AS p FROM symbol s LEFT JOIN refs r ON r.callee = s.symbol WHERE r.callee IS NULL) SELECT s.crate, z.kind, z.name, z.file, z.def_line, z.p FROM z JOIN symbol s ON s.symbol = z.symbol WHERE NOT (('/' || z.p) LIKE '%/tests/%' OR ('/' || z.file) LIKE '%/tests/%') AND NOT regexp_matches(z.p, 'impl#\[[^\]]*\]\[[^\]]*\]') ORDER BY z.file, z.def_line

WITH z AS (SELECT s.symbol, s.crate, s.kind, s.name, s.file, s.def_line, regexp_replace(s.symbol, '^rust-analyzer cargo \S+ \S+ ', '') AS p FROM symbol s LEFT JOIN refs r ON r.callee = s.symbol WHERE r.callee IS NULL) SELECT crate, kind, name, file, def_line, p FROM z WHERE NOT (('/' || p) LIKE '%/tests/%' OR ('/' || file) LIKE '%/tests/%') AND NOT regexp_matches(p, 'impl#\[[^\]]*\]\[[^\]]*\]') ORDER BY file, def_line
